name: service1
description: Public API that computes and returns the average score of whatever catalog Service2 currently serves: the sum of every record's score divided by the number of records, discarding any remainder. Runs the same computation regardless of which catalog Service2 serves — there is no separate path or result for any particular catalog. Holds no catalog data itself and does not switch Service2's mode. Returns a structured 404 body for any path it does not serve. Logs how many records it handled per request.

dependencies.name: service2
dependencies.description: Fetches the catalog Service2 currently serves, to compute its average score.
